# ParallelizedHierarchicalConnectome

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hierarchical network topology where parallel processing paths are organized in levels, mimicking brain connectome structure for efficient spiking signal routing. Enables scalable and efficient mapping of brain-like connectivity onto hardware, bridging TCC network design with iNEST spiking computation.
